semiconductor_relevance: Medium — DYT INC. provides specialized backup and RAID solutions for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, which are critical for data integrity and operational continuity.
summary: DYT INC. develops and manufactures automatic backup devices and RAID kits specifically designed for semiconductor and display manufacturing lines. Their patented Smart Backup Module (SBM) allows for the replacement of faulty storage devices without interrupting operations, a crucial feature for maintaining uptime in manufacturing environments.
capabilities: Smart Backup Module (SBM) for live disk replacement
Disk mirroring and duplication across SCSI, IDE, SATA interfaces
Noise filtered power modules for disk systems
